calls.statement:
SELECT
  AVG(weekly_total) AS average_stock_value_eur
FROM (
  SELECT
    fsw.week_ending_date,
    SUM(fsw.closing_value) AS weekly_total
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
    AND dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND ds.store_id < 900
    AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
) weekly_totals

SELECT
  fsw.week_ending_date,
  SUM(fsw.closing_value) AS weekly_total_eur
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND ds.store_id < 900
  AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
ORDER BY fsw.week_ending_date

FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date

  AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
